scope: The musical workflow with the keyboard only, with visible focus, resulting state and output
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform, software renderer, window 1060x1000

desktop-tests full runs.note: five consecutive direct runs, excluding the environment-dependent autosave probe test

verified_behaviors: 28 Tab stops reached from the current focus, each with visualFocus (or the grid's active focus) and its box inside the window
Ctrl+Shift+M, Space on buttons and check boxes, typed fields, arrow keys and Alt+arrows in the piano roll, Up in a combo box and spin boxes, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+S and Ctrl+E

Resulting state: two keyboard-entered notes (one moved to tick 216, one lengthened to 120 ticks and raised to pitch 65), a +12 transpose, level 75, scene membership, one automation point; Undo of a later level change
Saved project holds the device and the level; the float export is non-silent from frame 0
The track strip scrolls sideways and the editor pane vertically to keep focus visible; the status line has a fixed height so the layout does not jump
pointer_only: drawing a note at a pointer position in the grid (keyboard fields cover it)
dragging notes (arrow keys cover moves and resizes)
clicking an automation lane (typed fields cover it)
limits: Offscreen synthetic input; no screen reader (#80) or native Wayland (#22, #81) checks.
